Program-scoped tags are not in this export. The rungs also reference MainProgram-scope TIMER, COUNTER, ONS storage bits and raw analog input words (names ending _Raw, _Tmr, _Ons, and the drive I/O aliases). Those live in the program tag database and are not part of a controller-scope export.

Scan order follows product flow, so a stop upstream is seen by the machines downstream of it in the same scan.
Line aggregates and plant instrumentation last, once every machine has updated.
Permissive. The machine is Ready when it is in Auto, the E-Stop circuit is healthy and no fault is latched.
Start/stop seal-in. StartCmd is a momentary HMI bit; Running seals itself in until StopCmd, loss of the permissive, or the line stops.
Any non-zero fault code latches the machine faulted. FaultCode is written by the drive and safety fault handlers.
Operator reset. Stop pressed with the fault condition already cleared unlatches, one shot so a held button cannot chatter the latch.
